meaning.en: Not infectious, particularly with respect to a disease.

sentences.en: There were no differences in noninfectious complications or in mortality.

sentences.en: Conclus ions:The prevention and control of noninfectious chronic diseases and research of some related factors on poisonings and injuries should be strengthened.

sentences.en: Many infectious, noninfectious, and parasitic systemic diseases can cause blindness. Sexually transmitted diseases and rubella in pregnant women can cause blindness in their infants.
